mapper.sql: select group_id, group_code, group_name, lead_dept_id, description, status, sort, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_research_group where del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into biz_research_group (group_code, group_name, lead_dept_id, description, status, sort, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag) values (#{groupCode}, #{groupName}, #{leadDeptId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0')
mapper.update: update biz_research_group set group_code = #{groupCode}, group_name = #{groupName}, lead_dept_id = #{leadDeptId}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where group_id = #{groupId} and del_flag = '0'
